title: The Sweet Side of the Bitter Lesson — Thariq Shihipar, Independent
description:
Vibe coding a fighting game left Thariq Shihipar unsure how his own characters worked. At CODE Summit 2026, he revisits the Bitter Lesson, Bash, React and MCP, contrasting AI’s jagged frontier with its smooth interior. His live demo uses readable specifications, custom scripting languages and IDE workflows to show how coding agents can preserve creative control and help bring about a software renaissance.
